canonical_name: No Access Control and Validation Procedures
description: No procedures to control and validate physical access based on role or function, including visitor control.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare facilities and data centers Server rooms and network closets Workstations and portable devices accessing ePHI Storage media containing ePHI Physical access control systems

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review physical access control procedures including badge systems, visitor logs, and escort requirements. Verify that access is granted based on role-based authorization and that validation mechanisms are in place. Check for documented visitor management procedures, sign-in/sign-out logs, and controls for accessing areas with development or testing systems.

sources.title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C - Physical Safeguards
NIST SP 800-66 Rev 2 - Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule
